site.name: Corleone Guesthouse
site.description: The essence of architectural minimalism in the heart of the city. An exclusive retreat where every detail is stripped back to perfection.

home.heroDescription: The essence of architectural minimalism in the heart of the city. An exclusive retreat where every detail is stripped back to perfection.
home.sectionDescription: At Corleone Guesthouse, we believe true luxury lies in space and light. Our spaces are designed as art galleries, where essential furnishings and pure textures allow the mind to rest. No excess, only pure architectural presence.

cosaVisitare.title: Things to Do
cosaVisitare.description: Discover the hidden treasures of Corleone. A journey through unspoiled nature, deep history, and sacred architecture, just steps from our guesthouse.
cosaVisitare.descriptionMobile: Discover the hidden treasures of Corleone, just steps from the guesthouse.
cosaVisitare.readyDescription: Book your stay at CORLEONE GUESTHOUSE and use our guesthouse as the perfect base for your adventures.

due-rocche.title: Due Rocche Waterfall
due-rocche.description: A natural jewel nestled in the heart of Corleone. The San Leonardo river plunges forming a picturesque canyon, creating an oasis of peace and coolness, ideal for those seeking a relaxing break immersed in greenery, a short distance from the property.

cidma.title: CIDMA
cidma.description: The International Documentation Center on Mafias and the Anti-Mafia Movement offers a fundamental journey to understand the recent history of Sicily. A touching and necessary experience, housing the files of the Maxi Trial and testimonies of civil courage.

chiesa-madre.title: Mother Church
chiesa-madre.description: Dedicated to San Martino, the Mother Church is the spiritual and architectural heart of the city. With its majestic interiors and treasured artworks, it represents an excellent example of Sicilian religious architecture, a silent witness to centuries of Corleone's history.
